exact_statement: Let pi be the first finite concrete closed prefix containing an observed HI deadline miss. If pi has a legal reference-prefix extension and the concrete/reference event projection preserves the corresponding HI deadline observation, then the mapped reference prefix contains a corresponding HI bad event; this theorem performs only the concrete-to-reference bad-prefix mapping and does not prove the reference WCRT or protected-HI corollary.
conclusion: a first concrete HI bad closed prefix maps to a legal reference prefix containing a corresponding HI bad event
source_reference: This framework theorem interface, finite HI bad-prefix reflection
